title: Reverting a copy of a component's own opacity
goal: When you take a copy of a component and give it an opacity of its own, the panel is supposed to offer a small way back to the original's opacity, sitting on the Opacity row itself. That way back is not on screen: the Appearance section is not in the panel at all while a copy of a component is picked, so there is nothing to press.
notes: Reproduced on 2026-09-08 on an UNCHANGED checkout (stashed the panel-margin work, rebuilt, ran the walk): Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/panel-controls-walk.json fails at step 63 (press) with: no control called "Revert Opacity" is in the panel. The panel listing in the same error shows the sections that ARE there for a picked component copy: Layers, Effects, Component, Position & Size, Layout, Library. No Appearance section, so no Opacity row and no Revert Opacity. It fails identically with the panel-margin change applied, so it is not caused by it. The control is InstanceStyleRevert, put on the row by LayerStyleSlider when field: .opacity and there is a sole layer id (Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift, LayerStyleSlider); the Opacity row itself is PartsInspector.opacity. The question to answer first is why the .color section is not in the dock for a component instance selection: LayersPanel.swift around line 770 builds it, and Appearance appears for a plain rectangle in the same walk.
acceptance: Picking a copy of a component shows the Appearance section with its Opacity row
Giving that copy an opacity of its own puts the way back on the Opacity row
Pressing it puts the copy back on the original's opacity
Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/panel-controls-walk.json passes end to end
